candidates.name: Renal Cell Carcinoma
support_spans: a right renal mass with areas of fat attenuation located in the upper pole
a fatty tumor thrombus within the right renal vein extending to its confluence with the inferior vena cava
candidates.why: The presence of a renal mass with fat attenuation and a tumor thrombus in the renal vein is suggestive of renal cell carcinoma.

candidates.name: Angiomyolipoma
support_spans: a right renal mass with areas of fat attenuation located in the upper pole
contradict_spans: a fatty tumor thrombus within the right renal vein extending to its confluence with the inferior vena cava
candidates.why: The presence of a renal mass with fat attenuation is also suggestive of angiomyolipoma, but the tumor thrombus is less typical for this diagnosis.

candidates.name: Liposarcoma
support_spans: a right renal mass with areas of fat attenuation located in the upper pole
a fatty tumor thrombus within the right renal vein extending to its confluence with the inferior vena cava
candidates.why: The presence of a fatty tumor and a tumor thrombus could also be seen in liposarcoma, although this would be an unusual location for a primary liposarcoma.

key_evidence_spans: a right renal mass with areas of fat attenuation located in the upper pole

candidates.name: Renal Cell Carcinoma with Vena Cava Tumor Thrombus
support_spans: a right renal mass with areas of fat attenuation
a fatty tumor thrombus within the right renal vein extending to its confluence with the inferior vena cava
candidates.why: The presence of a renal mass with fat attenuation and a tumor thrombus in the renal vein suggests a malignant process, specifically renal cell carcinoma.
candidates.protected_reason: This diagnosis may be overlooked due to the rarity of tumor thrombi in the renal vein and the need for careful imaging interpretation.

candidates.name: Angiomyolipoma with Vascular Pedicle
support_spans: a right renal mass with areas of fat attenuation
visible vessels extending into the renal cortex, a finding known as a “renal parenchymal vascular pedicle”
contradict_spans: a history of endometrioid endometrial carcinoma
candidates.why: The presence of a renal mass with fat attenuation and a vascular pedicle is suggestive of an angiomyolipoma, a benign tumor.
candidates.protected_reason: This diagnosis may be underconsidered due to the patient's history of malignancy, which might lead to an initial focus on metastatic disease.

candidates.name: Liposarcoma Metastasis to the Kidney
support_spans: a right renal mass with areas of fat attenuation
contradict_spans: a history of endometrioid endometrial carcinoma
candidates.why: The presence of a fat-containing mass in the kidney could represent a metastasis from a liposarcoma, although the patient's primary cancer was endometrial.
candidates.protected_reason: This rare possibility might be overlooked due to the focus on the patient's known primary malignancy and the unusual location of metastasis.
